description: Source code defining the Flask Blueprint class and related setup state, including methods for registering routes, error handlers, and template functions, as well as managing nested blueprints.

classes.name: Blueprint
classes.description: Represents a Flask blueprint, a collection of routes and app-related functions that can be registered on an application later, supporting nested blueprints and deferred registration.

classes.name: BlueprintSetupState
classes.description: Temporary holder object for registering a blueprint with the application, passed to callback functions during registration.

methods.name: add_url_rule
methods.description: Helper method to register a URL rule and view function to the application, prefixing with blueprint's URL prefix.

methods.name: record
methods.description: Registers a deferred function to be called when the blueprint is registered on an application.

methods.name: record_once
methods.description: Registers a deferred function that is only called once, even if the blueprint is registered multiple times.

methods.name: make_setup_state
methods.description: Creates a BlueprintSetupState instance for registration callbacks.

methods.name: register_blueprint
methods.description: Registers a nested blueprint within this blueprint, with optional override options.

methods.name: register
methods.description: Registers the blueprint's views and callbacks with the application, merging nested blueprints and setting up error handlers, view functions, and request hooks.

methods.name: _merge_blueprint_funcs
methods.description: Merges error handlers, view functions, and request hooks from the blueprint into the application.

methods.name: add_url_rule (blueprint method)
methods.description: Registers a URL rule with the blueprint, prefixing endpoint and URL with blueprint's settings.

methods.name: app_template_filter
methods.description: Decorator to register a custom Jinja filter globally, available in all templates.

methods.name: add_app_template_filter
methods.description: Registers a custom Jinja filter to the application, usable in all templates.

methods.name: app_template_test
methods.description: Decorator to register a custom Jinja test globally.

methods.name: add_app_template_test
methods.description: Registers a custom Jinja test to the application.

methods.name: app_template_global
methods.description: Decorator to register a global function in Jinja templates.

methods.name: add_app_template_global
methods.description: Registers a global function in Jinja templates.

methods.name: before_app_request
methods.description: Registers a function to run before every request, globally.

methods.name: after_app_request
methods.description: Registers a function to run after every request, globally.

methods.name: teardown_app_request
methods.description: Registers a function to run after each request, for cleanup.

methods.name: app_context_processor
methods.description: Registers a context processor for templates rendered by the application.

methods.name: app_errorhandler
methods.description: Decorator to register an error handler for all requests.

methods.name: app_url_value_preprocessor
methods.description: Registers a URL value preprocessor for all requests.

methods.name: app_url_defaults
methods.description: Registers a URL defaults function for all requests.
